def.brief: Review and adopt EARLIER work. This is not this run's implementation. The owner-authorized edits were already in the tree before run-20261030-063525-2d81 began. The root captured them read-only in ../.umbrella/selfhost-baseline/jokbo.json and jokbo.patch: head 5e0fb48, tracked diff sha256 ad3e9915..., AGENTS.md d1babdf4..., CLAUDE.md 336cc4fb.... The edits: README navigation; the Install note on Python 3.11+; the new 'Shared Claude and Codex guidance' section; the Commands intro; the hooks adapter paragraph; the new Versioning and 'Release and adoption' sections. Also the new AGENTS.md (the shared maintenance guide), CLAUDE.md (only '@AGENTS.md'), and engines.python '>=3.9' -> '>=3.11' in plugin.json and .claude-plugin/plugin.json (.codex-plugin/plugin.json has said '>=3.11' since 1.0.0). They are committed byte-for-byte; this task changes no line of them. Review against source, as AGENTS.md asks for documentation changes: (1) the five files equal the root's baseline; (2) every relative link and anchor in README.md and AGENTS.md resolves, and CLAUDE.md is only the import; (3) CLI examples: 'python3 jokbo.py --help' lists file/since/find/index/map/note, each '<command> --help' has --target, and the /jokbo:* adapters call jokbo.py; (4) host packaging and version metadata: version 1.8.1 equal in the three manifests and both .claude-plugin/marketplace.json fields; engines.python '>=3.11' in all three; .agents/plugins/marketplace.json names jokbo at ./ with no version field; plugin.json extensions.com.openai.hooks is ./hooks/codex.json; the Codex manifest exposes ./skills/ (skills/read/SKILL.md); hooks.json and codex.json call the same six handlers with python3; (5) 'git diff --check' clean. Review notes, recorded here and not changed: the 3.11 floor is the owner's declaration. The source parses under 3.9 and 3.10 grammar, no 3.11-only API was found, and nothing was run on 3.9/3.10 (no such interpreter here). The Claude manifest declares no skills path; Claude finds skills/ by its default layout. The previous run's two Codex newbie findings on this text stand (README target resolution; no adoption-verification procedure). No version bump: raising the floor is handled by task 'version-policy'. No new Codex newbie: the previous run's newbie already read this README text, so a repeat would be ceremonial.
